detailedExplanation: This note supports 5 source-backed questions on Declension recognition.

Latin noun endings show the word's grammatical job as well as number. Identify the dictionary form and stem, decide the required case and number from the sentence, then select the ending. Translate the function, not simply the first familiar meaning.
examTips: Mark the finite verb first, then use noun endings to assign subject, object and recipient roles.
Normal Latin word order can vary; the case, number, gender, person and tense endings cannot.
For English to Latin, build each required form before arranging the sentence.
